Michelangelo, you good to help me pack up?  Donatello, whatever's in that notebook, make sure you've got it all.  DaVinci - you're already packing so just keep doing that.

records.response_pred:
I'm still sitting there, watching the fire burn down to embers. I've been trying to get someone's attention for a while now, but the others just keep drifting off to sleep or getting lost in their own thoughts. I'm starting to feel like I'm the only one who's still awake.

I've been thinking about what Michelangelo said earlier. He was right, we should've been more proactive about telling his family about our flight path. I know we didn't want to burden them, but maybe we should've known that our destination was so far away, they'd have been worried about us long before we did.

I glance around the camp, trying to spot anyone who's still awake. There's Donatello sitting alone, staring into the flames with her eyes closed. She's been quiet all day, and I'm starting to worry that she's lost her appetite. I wonder if she's thinking about the same thing I am - that we should've told her about our flight path sooner.

I take a deep breath and try to focus on my game. I've been playing it for hours, and I'm starting to get into a rhythm. I let my mind wander, letting the game's music carry me away. But my thoughts keep drifting back to the others, wondering if we'll ever be rescued.

I push the thoughts away, trying to stay focused on the game. But it's hard to concentrate when you're not sure if anyone is even there. I glance around the camp again, hoping to spot someone who's still awake.

As I scan the darkness, I notice DaVinci sitting close to the fire, his eyes fixed on some point in the distance. He's still thinking about that raft plan, and I'm starting to worry that he might forget what we were talking about. I try to get his attention, but he doesn't even flinch.

I sigh and let my gaze wander back to the flames. I miss the others, and I wonder if I'll ever see them again. The silence is starting to feel oppressive, and I'm not sure if I can tolerate it much longer. I take a deep breath and try to shake off the feeling, focusing on the game instead.
